physics-h1-q2.title: Karo da aminci, jifa a kwance da ƙarfin jan ƙasa
physics-h1-q2.topic: Karo da aminci, jifa a kwance da ƙarfin jan ƙasa
physics-h1-q2.goal: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.
physics-h1-q2.material: An jefa ƙwai biyu masu nauyi ɗaya daga tsayi ɗaya, ɗaya a kan simintin ƙasa, ɗayan a kan matashi mai laushi. Wane kwatancen adadin kimiyya ne daidai, daga lokacin da kowane ƙwai ya taɓa saman har ya tsaya?
physics-h1-q2.thinking.0: Karo da aminci, jifa a kwance da ƙarfin jan ƙasa
physics-h1-q2.s.s1.prompt: An jefa ƙwai biyu masu nauyi ɗaya daga tsayi ɗaya, ɗaya a kan simintin ƙasa, ɗayan a kan matashi mai laushi. Wane kwatancen adadin kimiyya ne daidai, daga lokacin da kowane ƙwai ya taɓa saman har ya tsaya?
physics-h1-q2.s.s1.explain: Tun da canjin motsin (momentum) ƙwai biyun ($\Delta p$) iri ɗaya ne, impulse ($I = F\Delta t$) iri ɗaya ne. Matashi yana tsawaita lokacin karo $\Delta t$, yana rage matsakaicin ƙarfin bugu $F = \frac{I}{\Delta t}$, don haka ƙwan ba ya fashewa.

physics-killer-10.title: Tasirin photoelectric da halaye biyu na haske, duniyar ƙananan abubuwa
physics-killer-10.topic: Tasirin photoelectric da halaye biyu na haske, duniyar ƙananan abubuwa
physics-killer-10.goal: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.
physics-killer-10.material: A gwajin photoelectric effect na haska haske mai launi ɗaya a kan wani farantin ƙarfe, sakamakon auna matsakaicin kuzarin motsi na photoelectrons a mitoci biyu yana kamar haka. A mita $7.5\times10^{14}\,\mathrm{Hz}$, $E_k=1.0\,\mathrm{eV}$; a mita $9.0\times10^{14}\,\mathrm{Hz}$, $E_k=1.6\,\mathrm{eV}$. Planck constant shi ne $h=4.0\times10^{-15}\,\mathrm{eV\cdot s}$ (ƙima ta kusan don tambaya). Wane zaɓi ne ya haɗa daidai, bi da bi, mitar ƙofa $\nu_0$ na wannan ƙarfe, da ƙarfin lantarki mai tsayarwa (stopping voltage) $V_0$ lokacin da aka haska haske mai mita $12.0\times10^{14}\,\mathrm{Hz}$?
